passes.question: why did Keychains do badly in July
passes.answer:
Unusual: the department shortfall in July is almost entirely one SKU — Tilda Charm (TIL-CM-GLD) — which finished 26.1% below target (actual revenue S$22,490.00 vs target S$30,427.80), leaving S$7,937.80 revenue at risk.  

What the diagnostic found: a small price effect worked in our favour (realised price S$65.00 vs target S$61.10, +S$1,349.40 explained), but the bulk of the gap is a residual demand shortfall of 152 units (residual -S$9,287.20, confidence: high). The SKU underperformed its model (-13.1%) and the department (-8.8%), and only 17% of the gap is explained by measured factors, so most of the shortfall remains unexplained.
passes.note: department-level why - find_exceptions, not explain_gap (which is per-SKU). Keychains did miss target, so the premise is sound.
